row.body: The sales receipt marks a car delivered, while the test-drive log starts after its keys were returned. A note asks whether the fuel charge belongs to the buyer.
row.title: The car with no return trip

sidecar.gloss: A vehicle is marked delivered before its test drive is logged.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency transport could also create a delayed fuel charge and key return; the record does not identify the drive.
